import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart' show Widget, Text;

/// A documented class.
abstract class Shape<T extends num> implements Comparable<Shape<T>> {
  static const int sides = 4;
  final T width;
  late final String label;
  Shape(this.width, {required this.label, int depth = 2});
  factory Shape.unit() => _Unit<T>();

  double get area;
  @override
  int compareTo(Shape<T> other) => area.compareTo(other.area);
}

enum Color { red, green, blue }

mixin Logging on Object {
  void log(String message) => print('[$runtimeType] $message');
}

extension on String {
  String get shout => '${toUpperCase()}!';
}

Future<int> compute(List<int> values, {bool fast = false}) async {
  var total = 0;
  for (final v in values) {
    if (v > 10 && !fast) continue;
    total += v ~/ 2;
  }
  final text =
      'multi ${values.length} "q" \n'
      r'raw $notInterpolated';
  final multi =
      '''
    triple $total
  ''';
  await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 10));
  return total ?? 0;
}

void main() {
  final map = <String, dynamic>{
    'a': 1,
    "b": [1, 2],
  };
  switch (map['a']) {
    case 1:
      break;
    default:
  }
  // trailing comment
  /* block */
  print(map?['b']?.length);
}
